entries.replacement: Host source and declaration builds invoke the exact installed tsc binary.
A standalone strict no-emit project checks every scripts/**/*.ts file with TypeScript 7.0.2.
Generated import and JSX checks use the catalog-pinned OXC parser and never load TypeScript's JavaScript compiler API.
Next 16.3.3 documents the project-local tsc CLI path for TypeScript 7.0.2; a fresh generated Next production build remains the release proof.

All generated apps and shared packages use the single TypeScript 7.0.2 catalog pin. Installed TanStack/Vite/Nitro, Expo, Electron and Eve gates remain required. test:convex-codegen verifies real root/component codegen with --typecheck=enable, strict generated contracts, rejected type errors, restoration and backend cleanup. Convex owns a separate strict tsconfig with Node ambient types. CI runs this gate on every supported OS with the catalog Node LTS. Source audits and manifest checks do not prove runtime compatibility.
Doctor reads exact installed TypeScript package metadata without executing bunx or untrusted project-local binaries, and executable probes fail closed on spawn errors.
Desktop resolves aliases relative to each tsconfig without baseUrl. Installed standalone and multi-app desktop typecheck/build gates verify the TypeScript 7.0.2 toolchain.
